messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look calendar of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(These are the federal holidays that fall on or near a weekend; provincial holidays that create extra long weekends are omitted.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Weekend span (including the holiday) |
|---------|-------------|--------------------------------------|
| New Year’s Day (observed) | Jan 2 (Mon) | **Sun Jan 1 – Mon Jan 2** |
| Family Day (Ontario, etc.) | Mar 20 (Mon) | **Sat Mar 18 – Mon Mar 20** |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Fri) | **Fri Apr 7 – Mon Apr 10** |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Mon) | **Sat May 20 – Mon May 22** |
| Canada Day (observed) | Jul 3 (Mon) | **Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3** |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Mon) | **Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4** |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Mon) | **Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9** |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Fri) | **Fri Nov 11 – Sun Nov 13** |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Mon) | **Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25** |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tue) | **Mon Dec 25 – Tue Dec 26** |

> **Note:**  
> • Some provinces observe different holidays (e.g., Family Day in Alberta is on Feb 20, while British Columbia has a different holiday).  
> • If you’re targeting a specific province, let me know and I can adjust the list accordingly.
